name: comp-142
title: Checkbox With Expansion
description: A labelled checkbox with a short description that, when ticked, unrolls a full-width text field and puts the cursor in it. Unticking folds the field away and disables it.
use: Ticking a box should branch into one more detail, such as a reason or a date, without leaving the page.
avoid: Only one field is revealed, its copy is fixed, and the input carries a hardcoded id.
a11y: Checkbox, description and the revealed field are all labelled, but the height transition ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small square checkbox sits left of a bold label and a grey description line on a near-black stage. Once ticked, the box fills light and a rounded outlined text field opens below the description, spanning the row.
behaves: Ticking grows the hidden field open with a smooth height change and moves focus straight into it; unticking collapses it and greys it out. The label and description stay in place above.
customise: Nothing is a prop: label, description and placeholder are literals and the field's id is hardcoded, so reuse means editing the file.
weight: light: A checkbox, a small text block and a grid-row height transition.
